messages.context: Rabbit Uncle 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fCuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.
messages.text: Cuz might not have the typical athlete's discipline, but he's clutch.
messages.zh: Cuz 或许没有典型运动员的自律,但关键时刻绝对靠得住。

messages.context: Rabbit Uncle 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fJust like my old teammate who didn't show up to every practice, but could score tuddies when it mattered most.
messages.text: Just like my old teammate who didn't show up to every practice, but could score tuddies when it mattered most.
messages.zh: 就像我以前那个队友:不是每次训练都来,可到了紧要关头总能达阵得分。

messages.raw: §fI used to chuck that ball like nobody's business. Those were the days, eh?
messages.text: I used to chuck that ball like nobody's business. Those were the days, eh?
messages.zh: 想当年我那一手传球,谁见了不服气? 那才叫好日子啊。

messages.raw: §fStill got some of those moves, you know.
messages.text: Still got some of those moves, you know.
messages.zh: 别看我现在这样,当年的本事可没全丢。

messages.raw: §aHoppity's §flike the star quarterback of this chocolate game. Always looking for that next big play.
messages.text: Hoppity's like the star quarterback of this chocolate game. Always looking for that next big play.

segments.text: like the star quarterback of this chocolate game. Always looking for that next big play.
segments.zh: 就像巧克力界的明星四分卫,总在琢磨下一次怎么打出漂亮的进攻。

messages.zh: Hoppity 就像巧克力界的明星四分卫,总在琢磨下一次怎么打出漂亮的进攻。

messages.raw: §fHe's got that championship mindset, just like I had.
messages.text: He's got that championship mindset, just like I had.
messages.zh: 他那股非拿冠军不可的劲儿,跟当年的我一个样。
